register.labelZh: WAVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: wave down、wave on 和 wave through 分別表示三種不同手勢:停下、繼續前進和通過。；wave somebody off 可以表示某人出發上學、旅行或前往其他地方時,向對方揮手道別。；wave something aside 可以表示警告、擔憂、問題或抗議被視為不重要。；wave something around 或 about 可以描述某人在空中揮動旗幟、門票、紙張或圍巾。
register.summaryEn: Wave down, wave on and wave through describe three very different hand signals: stop, continue and pass. Wave somebody off describes saying goodbye with a wave when someone leaves for school, a journey or another place. Wave something aside can show that a warning, concern, question or protest was treated as unimportant. Wave something around or about helps you describe someone moving a flag, ticket, paper or scarf in the air.
